column1: # fast-gate probe registry. TAB-separated.
#   id
# kind=cmd: a SELF-GATING check command (host unit tests / GPU oracle gates). col3 = command,
# col4 = args (or -), col5/col6 = placeholders/extra-env. Gate = exit 0; pins no golden.
# prompt: a token-ids file (fed as raw ids — ONLY valid for the model family that produced
# them) or @<textfile> (tokenized by the model's own tokenizer via MEMRA_PROMPT_FILE — safe
# across families). Gemma probes reuse the battery's pinned gemma ids; every other family
# uses the shared text probe.
# argmax probes run run-gen with MEMRA_NGEN=<ngen>; the gate is (1) the run-gen argmax
# MATCH line + no MISMATCH-STRUCTURED, and (2) the `tokens:` line byte-equal to the pinned
# golden in goldens/<id>.tokens (goldens refresh ONLY at full-battery green points).
# spec probes run run-spec at the single MEMRA_SPEC_K pinned in extra-env (the K=1..8 sweep
# stays tier-2); their gate is the SELF-CONSISTENCY PASS line plus the same golden pin on
# the plain-generate `tokens:` line.
# Shared-kernel representatives plus variant probes for loader/dispatch surfaces no representative
# reaches (see map.tsv header and the per-probe notes below):
# g12d: DEPTH probe (the battery's 1736-id depth prompt) — the gemma fp8-KV g-module FA arms
# (hd512 dpl16 globals + windowed hd256) actually execute at t_kv ~1740; the 19-id gemma
# probes decode below the t_kv=96 vec floor and never leave the scalar arm. (The ~100-token
# text probes q9/q35/etc DO exercise the default-module v4 hd256 arm already.)
# ngen=16, NOT 20: g12 depth prime is run-to-run NONDETERMINISTIC at a near-tie — token 17
# flips 107<->45518 (~1/8 runs, prefill logit maxdiff 2.438 vs 2.492 run-to-run; receipts
# research/fast-gate-20260802/g12-depth-nondeterminism.log). The first 16 generated ids were
# stable across every observed run; a 20-token golden false-fails ~1/8.
g12d
# e4b is not a redundant Q4_0 golden: it is the only arm that reaches Gemma-4's per-layer
# embeddings, KV-sharing loader/forward path, and the E4B-only glue kernels.
e4b
q9
# k27 pins MEMRA_FA_SPLIT=8 (lane/k27-divergence, research/k27-divergence-20260805/VERDICT.md):
# goldens are minted on the 82-SM 5090 whose fa_split_keys ladder gives split 8 at this probe's
# t_kv (96-110); any rig with fa_sm_count()>=128 defaults to split 16 = different FA-decode
# split-K reduction segmentation, and generated index 6 sits at t_kv=96 (the vec floor) on a
# near-tie (margin 0.04 vs step-median ~9.4) that the split size flips — the v0.70.0 release
# battery's pod red. The pin is a NO-OP on the 5090 (default already 8 here, md5-verified) and
# makes the probe test the same arithmetic the golden was minted under on every rig. Cross-rig
# TF logs at matched split are byte-identical to every printed digit — no silicon/toolkit gap.
# q35 chat-wrapped: the raw continuation hits EOS after 1 token (a 1-id golden is no net).
# q35slru: SAME model FORCED into the spill regime — MEMRA_MOE_RESIDENT=0 kills the resident
# slabs AND MEMRA_MOE_SLOTS=1024 caps the SLRU below the bank (~1GB vs 15.6GB), so prewarm can
# cover only layer 0 and every other layer rides the staged miss path (SLRU dispatch, eviction,
# H2D staging, moe_cached_gemm*). On a 24GB rig every resident-fitting probe (q35, g26, o35,
# kat) NEVER exercises that dispatch class — a break there was demonstrably invisible to the
# plain q35 probe (research/fast-gate-20260802/break-moe-staged-*). Uncapped RESIDENT=0 is not
# enough either: the default SLRU budget still swallows the whole bank and the dev-from-slots
# arm serves everything. This probe exists so the moe_cache/spill/staged rows have a probe
# that EXERCISES them.
q35slru
aw35
o9
# kat shares qwen35moe geometry, but it is the only arm with non-expert IQ4_XS trunk weights;
# it alone reaches qmatvec_iq4_XS_dp4a and the dense IQ4_XS MMQ arm.
kat
# spec probes (ONE K each — the K=1..8 sweep is tier-2).
# kind=spec  -> run-spec at MEMRA_SPEC_K (qwen MTP/NextN family); gate = SELF-CONSISTENCY PASS
#               + golden pin on the plain-generate tokens line.
# kind=gspec -> gemma-gate at MEMRA_SPEC (gemma assistant-drafter family, the battery's own
#               invocation); gate = "stream agreement ngen/ngen" (spec self-compares vs plain
#               in the same run — no separate golden needed).
q35spec
# cmd probes (self-gating; exit 0 = PASS). NOTE the greedy blind spot they close: every argmax
# probe runs temp=0, which routes around the sampler chain entirely — a broken sampler or
# spec-sample kernel is INVISIBLE to token goldens (demonstrated in
# research/fast-gate-20260802/break-sampling-*). sample-check oracles spec_sample.cu on-GPU;
# the memra-sampling host chain has its own cargo unit tests.
samp
sampt
g31spec
# chunkinv/chunkinvc: chunked-prefill reduction-order stability (lane/chunk-invariance ->
# lane/chunkinv-flip, research/chunk{-invariance,inv-flip}-20260805). The grain-free fix
# dropped the base_len==0 f32 special case, so prefill is chunk-INVARIANT BY DEFAULT (naked
# env, byte-identical logits across MEMRA_PRIME_CHUNK values). `chunkinv` asserts that
# byte-identity with NO env; `chunkinvc` is its canary — it INJECTS a break (turns the
# MEMRA_PRIME_F32CHUNK0 legacy-arithmetic rollback seam ON, which restores the chunk-variant
# class edge) and PASSES only if that breaks the expect-invariant assertion, so the gate is
# proven able to detect the mechanism (vLLM #40372's pattern: pin the property with an
# asserted test, not a prose note). A canary that flipped only the EXPECTED label would be
# perfectly correlated with the default gate and prove nothing — that trap is documented in the
# gate script's header because this lane wrote it wrong twice.
chunkinv
chunkinvc
# chunkinv35/chunkinv35c: the SAME assertion on the LAUNCH SKU (Step-3.7-Flash), whose SWA prefill
# had its own chunk-variant door — different arch, different mechanism, therefore its own arm
# (lane/step35-chunkfix, research/step35-chunkfix-20260807). Two things make the qwen arm above
# blind to it: (1) its pinned prompts are 96/147 tokens, BELOW step35's 512-token SWA window, so
# every chunk took the same kernel and the gate compared one kernel against itself; (2) its canary
# seam (MEMRA_PRIME_F32CHUNK0) is read in full_attn_prime_fa_dispatch, which step35 never reaches
# — the canary was INERT on this arch. This arm fixes both: prompt-pp6257 (T=4883, past the
# window) and the MEMRA_STEP35_SWA_TKV seam (the pre-fix predicate, chunk-variant by construction).
# The chunk set spans both sides of the defect's closed form P = c*floor(win/c): 4096/513 gave P=0,
# 512/256/64 gave P=512, and pre-fix those families disagreed pairwise while agreeing within.
# Artifact is box-staged (MEMRA_STEP37_GGUF or ~/step37/...); SKIPs cleanly when absent.
chunkinv35
chunkinv35c
# tickinv35/tickinv35c: the SECOND segmentation axis on the launch SKU — serve's per-tick
# prime_cache calls (one per scheduler tick), the level ABOVE chunkinv35's inside-one-call split.
# Each call computed its own seq_end, so step35's SWA arm predicate differed BETWEEN calls:
# budgets 1024/513 EXACT, 512/256/64 DIFFER 1.813e0 at greedy step 6 (the original defect's exact
# signature — research/step35-chunkfix-20260807 §9, raw/tickinv35-20260807T022010Z.log). Dark
# lanes default to budget 256 AND cap by live SLO headroom = LOAD-DEPENDENT segmentation; the
# interactive lane is reachable via the prefix-cache LCP split (any LCP in [64,512]) — the
# --splits arms pin that off-grid-resume hole (vLLM #51113's second law). REGISTERED RED by
# lane/tick-seg 2026-08-07; the fix in the adjacent commits turns it green. Seam
# MEMRA_PRIME_CALLLOCAL = rollback to per-call seq_end (tick-variant by construction — teeth).
tickinv35
tickinv35c
# ppsplit/ppsplitc: PRIME PP schedule identity + liveness. Three arms share one sharded load:
# unsplit reference, serial stage split, and chunk-pipelined stage split. Returned
# logits/h_seed/full hidden stack plus teacher-forced continuation logits must be bit-identical;
# PRIME_SPLIT_CHUNKS proves both split arms ran, and PRIME_PIPE_OVERLAPS proves the pipelined
# arm issued stage0(N+1) before draining stage1(N). Needs the 2-GPU placement; SKIPs locally.
# ppsplitc forces only the pipeline arm back to the serial split, so split liveness remains
# green and the overlap assertion alone must bite.
ppsplit
ppsplitc
# b2geo35/b2geo35c: batched-decode GEOMETRY on the launch SKU — step35 served at c=2/c=4 on the
# DEFAULT batched scheduler over PP-2 must return byte-identical greedy text to the c=1 reference
# AND prove a B>1 batched step35 tick actually ran (spawn-log chunk cap >= 2 + the engine's
# one-shot [step35-batch] first-B>1 line). The second assertion is what keeps the gate from going
# vacuously green under the fail-closed B=1 pin (chunk_cap_for=1 makes identity hold trivially).
# The pre-fix failure was HTTP-200 GARBAGE: over PP-2 a B>1 tick walked the generic Full arm —
# global n_head=96 over-reading wq on the 12 full-attn layers, 128-dim rope on all 45 layers, no
# SWA window, no head-wise gate (research/step-sku-20260807/raw/b2ab-pre-20260807T091553Z.log).
# REGISTERED RED by lane/step35-batched-decode 2026-08-08; the batched arm's commits turn it
# green. Canary: MEMRA_STEP35_BATCH=0 re-pins B=1 chunks — the evidence assertion must fail.
# Needs 2 GPUs + the staged artifact; SKIPs cleanly when absent.
b2geo35
b2geo35c
# gwstress: the MEMRA_GRAPH_WARMUPS=1 pool-growth adversarial gate (lane/graph-warmups) —
# large<->small session cycles + overlap arm force captures over freed async-pool blocks;
# bit-identity vs eager is the arbiter (#68's class corrupts without faulting) and the
# canary arm proves the comparator can catch injected graph-memory corruption. ~1 min (q9,
# 3 cycles at tier-1; local-ci runs the full 10). Guards capture_graph + the GraphSession
# capture/recapture path.
gwstress
# isogap/isogapc: the STAGGERED-DEPTH serve isolation contract at the engine tick
# (lane/iso-gap, task #91, research/iso-gap-20260807/): a session's logits bit-identical
# solo-vs-coresident ACROSS a fa_split_keys rung boundary — the shape both the equal-depth
# serve gate and the kernel-check seqs-vs-loop pin were blind to (all their depths sit in one
# rung). The straddle is placed per-rig (--auto scans the SM-keyed ladder), so the arm has
# teeth on the 82-SM 5090 AND the 188-SM pod. isogapc = canary (wrong token injected into the
# co-resident arm's feed; comparator must catch it — changes the WORLD, not the label).
# NOTE the serve-level solo-vs-loaded byte drift (spec-gate REF/REF_LOAD, byte 1347) is NOT
# this class: it is the documented b_n==1 fused-trunk<->batched-body config flip at the
# co-residence boundary (measured: O2==O3S==O3L byte-identical under B1FAST=0+GS=0). This arm
# pins the within-config isolation that fix relies on.
isogap
isogapc
# amargin/amarginc: the CALIBRATED prefill-vs-decode argmax gate (lane/q8-argmax,
# research/q8-argmax-20260806/VERDICT.md). run-gen's own gate asserts forward_last and the
# decode_step loop agree at ONE position (the last) and calls any disagreement a "cache
# threading bug" — which is how the 27B Q8_0 x board-2048 pair sat red on the 188-SM pod from
# v0.69.0 through v0.71.0 with nothing wrong: that position is a THREE-WAY near-tie (top-3
# inside 0.05, prompt median top-2 gap 1.25) and the two configs pick differently. Refuted as
# causes: the k27 FA-split rung (8/16/1 identical), MEMRA_Q80_G2, chunked prefill, and every
# fast kernel at once (the MEMRA_FAST=0 f32 oracle flips the same pair).
# The real hole this closes is COVERAGE: one-position checking makes greenness depend on
# whether a prompt's LAST token happens to be a near-tie. Measured — the 27B NVFP4 arm the
# release battery calls green carries a flip at pos 2042 whose margin (0.0184) is SMALLER than
# the failing arm's (0.0307). This gate checks the last 24 positions and asserts every flip is
# explained by a margin the config spread can reach across; a WIDE-margin flip (the genuine
# cache/kernel-bug signature) fails at any position. amarginc is its teeth: it fault-injects a
# wide-margin flip row and PASSES only if the comparator rejects it.
# map.tsv dispatches both arms for the forward_last/decode-step implementation surfaces and
# for this gate's own wrapper/probe; sampled-spec and served acceptance retain samp/accept.
amargin
amarginc
# c=64 serving concurrency stress (lane/admit-oom, 2026-08-06): 64 staggered streaming clients
# against a live memra-server. Guards the admission VRAM cost model (spec transient reserve) +
# the step-OOM park-requeue — the pair that turned the c=64 red (0/64 well-formed, 64x
# CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY) into 64/64 paced. ~2 min (server load + ~60s burst). Its teeth arm
# lives in local-ci's doc, not here: `tools/serve-stress-gate.sh --teeth`.
sstress
# accept: SERVED-SPEC ACCEPTANCE + LONG-TEXT assertion (lane/accept-gate, 2026-08-06). Closes
# the blind spot receipted in research/f8f4-flip-20260806: every probe above is either a
# 20-token golden or an in-arm self-consistency check, so a change that moves served greedy text
# at generated index 22+ AND moves spec acceptance by -9.5pp passes all of them. Worse, a
# --refresh-goldens after such a change silently re-pins the new arm. This probe asserts exact
# (rounds, drafted, accepted) counts + the full text sha256 to ngen=128 at the PRODUCTION serve
# config (real regime drafter, real serve K) — the drafter matters because the acceptance sign
# follows (model x drafter x prompt) and INVERTED between the bare MTP head and the regime
# drafter on the same models the same day. Smoke tier here (q27-p1, ~1 min); the 6-cell matrix
# is `--full`. Teeth: `tools/accept-gate.sh --teeth` (MEMRA_MMQ_F8F4=1 must FAIL it).
accept
